baseline.method: Reproduced unchanged original ZDIpy brightness maximum-entropy reconstruction

nrmse_definition: RMS spatial error divided by reference dynamic range, independently per required component.
reference_kind: standard-method result; no actual surface truth
observation_metric: mean squared standardized residual over all 16 by 89 measured samples; diagonal variance assumption
evaluation_semantics: Method-independent maximum relative entropy with fixed unit photosphere, subject to independently evaluated full spectral chi-square; attainable entropy cost is a bound, not image truth.
baseline_role: Historical v1 numerical/stage comparison and attainable source observation fit; self-agreement values are not current acceptance criteria.
